status: PROPOSED ONLY: no instrumentation implemented, built, or executed
purpose: Distinguish recurrent reset metadata errors, nonfinite state surviving SCALE(0), and later arithmetic divergence in matched immediate repeated requests.

configuration.enable: Proposed FLASHNEXT_RESET_DIAG=1; absent or 0 must allocate no diagnostic buffers, issue no extra copies/waits, and emit no diagnostic logs. Read environment once.
configuration.selection: Single slot, no concurrency, no speculation. Preserve current model, image, OPT, fusion, checkpoint, batch and request settings. Keep SYCL_CACHE_PERSISTENT=0.
configuration.arming: Explicit diagnostic arm file created after model readiness and screening, before the matched request sequence; log arm receipt and request ordinal. No controller modification proposed here.

state_families: P PLE convolution if present on selected layer

configuration.overflow: Emit skipped/limit reason, never truncate while claiming full-row validation. Stop capturing at bound; keep inference semantics unchanged.

patch_plan.change: Diagnostic-only request/reset ordinal and record seq_rm return value, slot, requested p0/p1, n_past, prompt hash/token count and sequence pos_min/max before/after. Keep original call count exactly one. Record failure explicitly; do not silently force a reset.
patch_plan.invariant: With cache_prompt=false, n_past=0 and reset range [0,end) must succeed before first prompt batch.

patch_plan.change: Log post-removal metadata and selected active cell mapping after find_slot. In s_copy, record existing local rollback idx before its existing single-use reset, src0, computed row index, cell ID, seq ID, head, n, rs_z and batch ordinal. Do not call s_copy an extra time; it consumes rs_idx.
patch_plan.invariant: Fresh sequence has rollback idx0 and new cell src0==rs_z>=0. Continuation ubatch is not expected to reset; distinguish it by positions.

patch_plan.change: When diagnostic is armed, label only selected reset SCALE node with state family/layer/base row identity and emit tensor shape/type/strides/offset metadata. Follow view_src to named cache_r_lN/cache_s_lN/cache_ple_r_lN. Handle zero-sized no-op without reading. Names alone must not set OUTPUT flags, add graph nodes or alter fusion policy.
patch_plan.invariant: Capture exact row view of state_size elements; do not read entire recurrent allocation or unrelated rollback snapshots.

patch_plan.change: Preferred narrow GPU observation is inside ggml_sycl_op_scale only for diagnostic-selected reset nodes with scale0,bias0,F32 contiguous. Queue pre-copy of exact view to owned host vector, wait_and_throw, execute existing scale_f32_sycl once, queue post-copy and wait_and_throw, then compute host summaries. Use ctx.stream() for both copies. Keep buffers alive through waits. Do not invoke a backend sync that recurses from backend compute.
summary: byte SHA256 in offline collector over bounded raw captures
first bounded nonzero/nonfinite indices and raw float bits
patch_plan.invariant: Post-row all values numerically zero and finite; signed zero reported separately. SCALE uses scale*x+bias, so NaN/Inf before operation can survive. Do not change SCALE to memset in a diagnostic arm.

patch_plan.change: Attach monotonic decode/ubatch ordinal, token-position bounds and stable token-byte hash to metadata to associate repeated graphs and GPU captures. Graph reuse must be represented; graph construction count is not decode count.

Optional SECOND diagnostic arm: capture actual l_last layer0 output and result_output logits using existing eval callback plumbing. Select actual tensor names from callback, record type/shape/strides and token positions. For a tiny activation capture read one complete logical vector for the last token of each selected prompt ubatch; explicitly handle HC dimensions/strides. For first sampled-token logits capture full vocabulary vector already copied to host when possible; checksum only after existing completion synchronization. Compute SHA256 offline over canonical raw little-endian F32 bytes; preserve NaN and signed-zero bits.
patch_plan.limit: Maximum two activation vectors and one full logits vector per request. Sampled activation checksum is not a full-layer checksum. Full-vocabulary copy must respect byte bound.

ordering_evidence: llama-graph.cpp:3653 expands SCALE before gather at3661.
ggml-sycl.cpp:3433 uses ctx.stream(); common.hpp:411 uses dpct default_queue; helper.hpp:731,794 selects in-order queue.
Backend-local pre-copy/wait, existing SCALE, post-copy/wait is ordered on that queue. Added waits may hide an existing race; passing diagnostic cannot prove production ordering correct.

ggml-backend.cpp:1890-1923 eval callbacks split graph and synchronize backend before data callback. This can prevent cross-boundary fusions. Use activation callback only as a separate arm, never conflate it with metadata-only or reset-only evidence.
known_contracts: Recurrent allocation zeros buffers at llama-memory-recurrent.cpp:117-123. Uninitialized initial state is not established.
seq_rm clears metadata rather than all physical bytes. Fresh state is zeroed lazily through graph SCALE. Prior nonfinite contamination is a hypothesis only.
Qwen4exp build_rs covers S state at1069 and convolution state at1313, including PLE via1421.

Attention seq_rm removes cell memberships (llama-kv-cache.cpp:400); mask rejects empty/other-sequence rows (1659+). Hybrid index reset invalidates pools from0 (hybrid-idx.cpp:185-197,673+). Recurrent-only instrumentation cannot rule out QSA/attention issues.

cache_prompt=false bypasses checkpoint restoration, but checkpoint creation and artificial tail splits remain enabled. --ctx-checkpoints0 is an independent control that changes both snapshots and batch shape.

experiment_record.CONFIG: Record binary/image/source/patch hashes, model manifest, env, requests, context/batch/checkpoints/cache flags, selected layers and capture bounds.
experiment_record.COMMAND: Parent-owned leased launch only after source review; no commands executed by this plan. Run identical request sequence with diagnostic off, metadata only, then bounded reset observation. Optional activation callback is a separate later arm.
experiment_record.RESULT: Per-request token IDs/logprobs plus ordinal-linked metadata and raw capture hashes, resets observed/skipped counts, state summaries, health and teardown evidence. Never infer zero from a skipped row.
experiment_record.VERDICT: Mapping failure localizes metadata; nonfinite pre/post demonstrates SCALE cannot sanitize that row but does not locate first corruption; finite nonzero post suggests execution/selection issue; clean reset with divergent logits shifts investigation downstream. Any behavior change only under diagnostic waits is timing-sensitive, not a fix.

limitations: No GPU validation or kernel patch performed.
First selected recurrent layer coverage does not exclude later-layer corruption. Layer0 activation may precede or follow a recurrent layer according to actual model metadata; record both indices.
Byte checksum detects identity, not acceptable numerical tolerance or quality.
No broad full-tensor dump, model-weight dump, new compiler/toolchain, source refresh, or controller change proposed.
